name: print-social-weather-app-parody-cake-forecast-post
title: Weather-app parody with a floating cake and a week of cake slices
whatItIs: A portrait post that copies a weather app: a cloudy blue sky, 'HOME' and 'Today' at the top, a floating drizzle cake on a stand in place of the temperature, and a weekly forecast row where each day is a cross-section photo of a different cake. A '10-DAY FORECAST' bar peeks at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Witty and delicious; a familiar app frame makes a menu feel like something to check every day.
techniques: Recreate a familiar app interface using product photography as the data.
Replace icons with cake slices in a horizontal week strip.
Float the hero product in the sky like a weather symbol.
Keep the interface type thin and white for an authentic feel.
bestFor: Food and bakery menus and daily specials
Any brand able to parody a well-known interface

vocabulary.definition: Design that imitates an app to deliver a different message.
A row of seven items for days of the week.
A product suspended in the middle of a scene.
A close image showing layers inside a product.
